run_pretrain_job: run a submitit job to pretrain a ConvNeXt model on a SLURM cluster with multiple GPUs
submit_trainer: submit a Trainer instance to a submitit AutoExecutor for distributed pretraining on SLURM
parse_args_submitit: parse command line arguments for submitit pretrain including ngpus, nodes, timeout, and partition
checkpoint_trainer: checkpoint a Trainer to requeue and resume a pretraining job from a saved checkpoint file
setup_gpu_args: setup GPU arguments from submitit JobEnvironment including rank, world size, and output directory
